notes: Encoded ONLY from ICP Commercial's own page. No ICP-family page imported: the page states its own 10-character system. The page legend mentions month, but the text states positions for year and week only, so no month is encoded.

styles.notes: Page: 10-character serial. Year = 2nd & 3rd positions (1-based) -> normalized [1,3] = '05' -> 2005. Week = 4th & 5th positions -> normalized [3,5] = '16'. Example as printed on the page (G05 1650885, spaces stripped by normalization).
